incident: Auth gateway missing JWT issuer variable
symptoms: JWT validation logs showed issuer mismatch
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: JWT_ISSUER was changed in the deployment template but the corresponding production value was not updated.
successful_steps: Compared current and previous deployment environment values
resolution: A deployment configuration mismatch caused valid tokens to fail issuer validation. Restoring the expected issuer resolved authentication.
postmortem: Password rotation did not address token validation.
Restarting pods loaded the same incorrect value.
